title: DAVIXHUB | AUTOFARM EGGS | PLACE AND HATCH ALL EGGS | & MUCH
features:
Davix Hub is a complete script with a modern UI (WindUI) and multiple features to enhance your gameplay.

Main Features:
✅ Automated Auto Farm
✅ Auto Click 
✅ Auto Sell
✅ Auto Open Eggs + Auto Hatch
✅ Pet Selection with rarity filter
✅ Equip/Unequip Pets
✅ Remove All Pets
✅ Auto Collect All
✅ Rare Pets Only
✅ Steal Pets
✅ Speed Hack
✅ Teleport to locations (Spawn, Desert, Ocean, Forest, Cyber)
✅ Smart Server Hop
✅ Config System (Save/Load)
✅ Custom Keybinds
✅ 4 UI Themes (Darkness, White, Forsaken, Germany)
✅ Notifications

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

DETAILED FEATURES:

MAIN TAB:
• Auto Click
• Auto Farm
• Auto Sell
• Auto Equip Best
• Auto Open Eggs
• Auto Hatch
• Auto Collect
• Select Pet (Dropdown)
• Select Rarity (Dropdown: Common, Uncommon, Rare, Epic, Legendary, Mythic, Secret, Exclusive)
• Equip Pet
• Unequip Pet
• Remove All Pets

PLAYER TAB:
• Auto Collect All
• Rare Pets Only
• Steal Pets
• Speed Hack (WalkSpeed 100)

TELEPORT TAB:
• Recall (Teleport to 0,0,0)
• Server Hop (Switch servers)
• Location (Dropdown: Spawn, Desert, Ocean, Forest, Cyber)
• Auto Teleport

MISC TAB:
• Theme (Dropdown: Darkness, White, Forsaken, Germany)
• Auto Theme

SETTINGS TAB:
• Minimize Keybind (LeftControl)
• Column Keybind (LeftShift)
• Close Keybind (LeftAlt)
• Save Config (Toggle + Button)
• Config Name (Input)
• Info Panel

EXTRA:
• Notification System
• Auto Load Config
• Smart Server Hop (avoids already visited servers)
• Pet Detection in Workspace
• Speed Hack with respawn reapplication
• Auto populates Pet Dropdown
